description: Work with your Hyros ad tracking: find and update leads, sales, calls and subscriptions, record orders, refunds, calls, carts and clicks, and pull attribution reports by ad or ad account. Start workflows on new leads, sales, calls, subscriptions and refunds.

hyros_new_call_trigger.description: Runs for each new call in Hyros, with its state, lead and the first and last source credited. Calls already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.externalId: Its id in the app it came from.
output.firstSource: The first source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.id: The call's id, for Update calls and Delete call.
output.lastSource: The last source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.lead: The lead: id, email, firstName, lastName and tags.
output.name: The call's name.

parameters.description: Only calls in this state: QUALIFIED, UNQUALIFIED, CANCELLED or NO_SHOW. Leave empty for every call.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Only calls with this tag (starting with $). Leave empty for every call.
parameters.name: product_tag

hyros_new_lead_trigger.description: Runs for each new lead in Hyros, with their email, tags, IPs and phone numbers. Leads already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The lead's id, for Get lead journey.
output.provider: The app the lead came from, if any.
output.tags: Their tags: sources (@), actions (!) and products ($).

parameters.description: Only leads with this tag, such as !opted-in. Leave empty for every lead.
parameters.name: tag

hyros_new_sale_trigger.description: Runs for each new sale in Hyros, with its price, product, lead and the first and last source credited. Sales already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.firstSource: The first source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.id: The sale's id, for Update sales.
output.lastSource: The last source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.lead: The lead: id, email, firstName, lastName and tags.
output.orderId: The order it belongs to, for Refund order.
output.price: price, discount, hardCost, refunded and currency.
output.product: The product: id, name, tag and category.

parameters.description: Only for this product, by its tag (starting with $). Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_tag

parameters.description: RECURRING for recurring payments only, NON_RECURRING for first-time sales only. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: recurring

hyros_new_subscription_trigger.description: Runs for each new subscription in Hyros, with its status, price, period, lead and sources. Subscriptions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.firstSource: The first source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.id: The subscription's id, for Update subscriptions.
output.lastSource: The last source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.lead: The lead: id, email, firstName, lastName and tags.
output.name: Its name.
output.periodicity: DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER or YEAR.
output.status: ACTIVE, TRIALING, CANCELED and so on.
output.subscriptionId: Its id in your billing app.

parameters.description: Only subscriptions in this status, such as ACTIVE or TRIALING. Leave empty for every status.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only for this product, by its tag (starting with $). Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_tag

hyros_sale_refunded_trigger.description: Runs when a sale made in the last 30 days is refunded, in full or in part, and again if more of it is refunded. Refunds made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.firstSource: The first source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.id: The sale's id, for Update sales.
output.lastSource: The last source credited: name, tag, organic, adSource (platform and ids) and its category.
output.lead: The lead: id, email, firstName, lastName and tags.
output.orderId: The order it belongs to, for Refund order.
output.price: price, discount, hardCost, refunded and currency.
output.product: The product: id, name, tag and category.

parameters.description: Only for this product, by its tag (starting with $). Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_tag
